question: How are the two items with thread-wound necks to be honored ritually?
premises: Two items have necks wound with three threads.
Flowers and other offerings are used.
inference: The two thread-wound items are worshipped with flowers and similar offerings.
uncertainties: The exact identity of the two items is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: The two, with necks wound by three threads, should be worshipped with flowers and other offerings.
